title: 5. What SRS needs: bugs and gaps found

sections.name: list
sections.label: The list
sections.content:
- Bug: a source document's content checksum has nowhere to live; the CLI computes it and drops it (srs#1053).
- Gap: relation rows are comma-joined by the spec, which is unreadable when titles contain commas.
- Gap: a slice cannot be byte-reproducible, because it must record exportedAt.
- Gap: a slice of a clean repository can warn about a lifecycle relation the slice itself cut.
- Data: muSrs citations had drifted outside the essay's references container.
- Friction (recorded in srs-context): the export commands take their output three different ways (archive pack --output, archive unpack --target, slice export <OUTPUT>), and slice export lives under srs slice, not srs container.

sections.name: not
sections.label: Checked and not a bug
sections.content: The I-81 identity-type message and the 'composition names a container not in the slice' message are info severity in a slice, as RFC-026 [R17] requires.
